finding: Forensic investigation of Package 109 Iteration 6 establishes dual failure mechanisms: small trial batches (B23, B11, B5) solve to completion but fail damage jump safeguard due to wake snap-through on previously released crack-tip nodes (Delta d up to 0.177, dmax jumping to 0.983 vs 0.05 allowance), while single-node release (B1, Node 2557) fails due to monolithic static Newton-Raphson divergence in increment 20 at step time 0.998493 with phase correction overshoot (Delta d = 5.27 at Node 2279) and 35 negative eigenvalues. Demonstrates COUPLED_NEWTON_DIVERGENCE and ACTIVE_SET_RELEASE_INSTABILITY requiring trust-region damped phase corrections.
